exposure: comprehensive management protocol (including warming equipment, plastic wrapping, aluminum-polyethylene sheet, and room temperature adjustments)
cohort: Extremely preterm newborns (EPNs) delivered at a single institution between January 2006 and December 2020 (n=432 total, n=80 for recent evaluation).
finding: The implementation of a comprehensive management protocol significantly reduced the rate of moderate admission hypothermia in extremely preterm newborns from 48% in 2006 to 8% in 2020.
birth_weight: Extremely preterm newborns with moderate-to-mild hypothermia had a significantly lower birthweight compared to those without hypothermia.
gest_age: Extremely preterm newborns with moderate-to-mild hypothermia had a significantly smaller gestational age compared to those without hypothermia.
